about: Reboot (types/0x0001-device.md §3.2) — mandatory: acknowledged, carried out after `delay` ms (at least 50, so the acknowledgement leaves first), the address kept. Without a restart hook the node does what a restart looks like from the bus: Booted with LastResetReason SOFTWARE (3), the boot counted. A missing argument is INVALID_VALUE.

steps.note: delay 0 still waits out the 50 ms
